scope: Limited energy-basis implications of carbohydrate corrections only; no repeat of completed energy arithmetic audit.
finding: The older CoFID energy basis uses available carbohydrate as monosaccharide equivalents at 3.75 kcal/g; UK by-weight labelling uses 4 kcal/g. Correcting grams does not justify subtracting four times the gram correction from stored calories. A future label-basis energy reconciliation would also need appropriate treatment of fibre, organic acids, alcohol and specific Atwater factors.
source: CoFID 2021 guide pp10 and16; FAO/INFOODS Conversion Guidelines 2012 table4.1-1
